recipes.description: Read and write files in a sandboxed workspace. The model gets read_file, write_file, list_directory, create_directory, move_file, and search_files tools scoped to the directories you allow.

config_options.name: allowed_directories
config_options.description: Directories the model is allowed to read and write. The default workspace is created automatically. Add additional paths to give the model access to e.g. a code repo.

recipes.description: Read and write files inside a single project root you select. Same six tools as the sandboxed recipe, but pointed at one tree of your choice — typically a code repo. Use this when you want the model to work end-to-end on a project without granting access to the rest of your machine.

config_options.name: allowed_directories
config_options.description: The single directory the model is allowed to read and write. Pick your project root. Add a second path if your project depends on a sibling directory; otherwise leave it as one entry.

recipes.description: UNRESTRICTED filesystem access. The model can read and write ANY file your user account can reach — your home directory, system config, SSH keys, every credential file. Same six tools as the sandboxed recipe, scoped to '/'. Only enable this when you understand the risk; install the recommended Cedar policy alongside it.
recipes.warning: This recipe gives the model read AND write access to your entire filesystem — including ~/.ssh, ~/.aws, every credential file, and every project on your machine. The Cedar policy gate is your only line of defense. Install the recommended policy template (filesystem-full-recommended.cedar) before enabling this recipe, and review every tool call.
